confirm.description:
Two or more pieces of DALI control gear on {title} share short addresses {addresses}. Home Assistant cannot control them individually, and commands meant for one reach all of them.

Select **Re-address gear** to clear the shared address and assign free short addresses to the affected gear. The fixture Home Assistant already knew at each address keeps that address, so your automations keep working; the newly added, conflicting fixture gets a free address and appears as a new device.

When Home Assistant never saw a single device at an address before the collision, it cannot tell which fixture should keep it, so the addresses are assigned arbitrarily and automations targeting that address may now control a different fixture.

If another DALI controller manages this bus, resolve the collision with that controller instead to avoid conflicts.
confirm.title: Resolve DALI short-address collision

bus_overload.description:
The DALI bus on {title} dropped below the voltage needed to communicate, even though its power supply is switched on. The bus power supply is most likely overloaded or undersized for the connected control gear and sensors. A long or faulty bus cable can have the same effect.

Use a DALI bus power supply with a higher current rating, reduce the number of devices on the bus, or check the bus wiring. Home Assistant keeps retrying and clears this issue once the bus is stable again.
bus_overload.title: DALI bus power supply overloaded on {title}

confirm.description:
The DALI bus on {title} has no power, so Home Assistant cannot reach any devices. This interface has an integrated power supply that can power the bus.

Select **Switch on bus power**, but only when no separate DALI power supply is connected, otherwise leave it off to avoid two power supplies on the bus.
confirm.title: Power the DALI bus

confirm.description:
Home Assistant found DALI control gear on {title} that has no short address. Without a short address, these lights cannot be controlled individually and do not appear in Home Assistant.

Select **Assign addresses** to assign free short addresses to these devices. Devices that already have a short address keep it.

If another DALI controller manages this bus, assign addresses with that controller instead to avoid conflicts.

After the addresses are assigned, the new lights appear in Home Assistant automatically.
confirm.title: Assign DALI short addresses
